note: Pages the source survey (tools/licence-terms/survey_sources.py) renders in a browser in CI, so a person can read their availability, provenance, update status and terms. Being listed here is not use: no candidate is fetched by any capture tool or shown in the app. URLs are starting points; the survey also follows links whose text names terms, licences, citation, downloads or updates.
